Refer also to Venefício (Poisoning), printed pages 73–84, for poison creation and lists. CLASSIFICATION Restricted Power — Dokujutsu (Art of Poisons). Purchase as a version of the Ninpou power, following the Ninpou rules in the Basic Book, page 84. PREREQUISITES Poisoning 4; Chemical aptitude. DESCRIPTION You use poisons as a primary fighting style, such as poisoned needles and toxic smoke. Choose a visual interpretation for your Dokujutsu. Scrolls may be used to depict summoned weapons or projectiles without requiring Fuuinjutsu, because this is only a visual interpretation of Ninpou. ENHANCED POISON Gain +2 free levels in Poisonmaking for tests and crafting prerequisites for poisons and antidotes. Your poisons use the special difficulty calculation, enhanced contagion methods, and grant access to Special Poisons. KEY ATTRIBUTE Poisoning replaces Spirit for Dokujutsu power parameters, including range, damage, and resistance-test difficulty. RANGE Medium: 10 m + 2 m per level of Poisoning. Creation and manipulation cannot exceed this range. SIZE Creations, manipulations, and areas of effect may have up to 1 m in diameter, length, width, or height per level of Venom (the translated source uses “Venom”). ENHANCED CONTAGION — INGESTION Choose an onset time between 1 minute and 24 hours when poisoning the food. ENHANCED CONTAGION — INHALATION Takes effect 2 turns after inhalation. A character trained in Poison Control must also test to recognize the poison and may use Poison Control or Natural Science. ENHANCED CONTAGION — TOUCH Takes effect 1 turn after contact with the target’s skin. Characters with Poison Effect must test to identify a poisoned attack and may use Poison Effect or Natural Science. ENHANCED CONTAGION — BLOODSTREAM A successful attack of level 2 or higher can inject the poison. POISON DAMAGE You may combine a chosen poison with Dokujutsu Ninpou effects. The effect deals its normal damage, and you may also attempt the poison’s permitted contagion method: inhalation, touch, or bloodstream. Inhalation only needs to reach the target (who may attempt the Natural Science breath-holding test); touch must hit; bloodstream must hit and deal damage of level 2 or higher. POISON RESISTANCE Difficulty is 8 + the Poisoning skill level. The English translation additionally refers to a +1 from Improved Poison; consult the Poisoning revision for how this applies. ALLOWED EFFECTS — LEVEL 1 Cannon. ALLOWED EFFECTS — LEVEL 2 Orb; Ray; Continuous Damage (GAS); Purify (GAS). ALLOWED EFFECTS — LEVEL 3 Arrows; Spear; Ricochet. ALLOWED EFFECTS — LEVEL 4 Column; Energize; Cloud; Destructive Breath. ALLOWED EFFECTS — LEVEL 5 Missile; Current; Explosive Wave; Blinding (GAS). ENERGIZE POISON Using the Dokujutsu Energize effect lets you affix one dose of poison to one weapon using chakra, turning it into a poisonous weapon.

The Eight Gates are eight specific points in a shinobi's chakra circulatory system that limit
the flow of chakra in their body, functioning as regulating valves. However, there are rare
ninjas who possess the ability to control these valves, releasing the flow of chakra to
abnormal levels and enhancing the body's abilities.
However, doing so causes serious damage to the body, as it is pushed beyond its limits.
Having the gates open causes changes in the user's appearance. The most common are
darkening of the skin, eruption of veins in the temporal region of the head, and completely
white eyes, as if they lacked iris and pupil, although this is not always the case. The
character's voice may also become deep for the duration of the release.

The user (rounded up) is a partial action. Releasing all at once is a move action.
The user can unlock gates gradually, always increasing the level, but cannot gradually
reduce it (if the gates are closed, they are all closed at once).
Duration: The first level of the Eight Gates lasts for 2 turns. From level 2 onwards, any gate
lasts for 5 turns. Releasing the gates gradually does not affect the total duration.
When the gates are closed, it is necessary to wait at least one shift before opening them
again.
Chakra Cost: Zero. Using this power does not consume chakra, however you suffer damage
to your Vitality each turn.
Damage per Turn: When opening the gate, the character will suffer damage to their Vitality
immediately and at the start of each subsequent turn. The damage amount is in the description of
each gate. As a general rule, from the 3rd Gate onwards, the damage is equal to the level used. If
the damage received reduces Vitality to zero or less, the gates are automatically closed.
The damage sustained from Hachimon Tonkou does not free the character from Genjutsu.
Instead, it reduces the difficulty of the resistance test against the illusion (see below).

deliver quick and powerful blows to the opponent, causing external damage. The
character receives additional weapon damage when attacking unarmed, according to
the rules of the Iron Fist skill.

For the high kick, the character makes a resisted Agility test against the target's
Readiness test. If successful, the target is considered feinted against the low kick.
When the character uses this technique in the company of another person, it is called
Konoha Tsumuji Senp-.

• With the Spinning Kick skill: receive a +2 damage bonus.

followed by two more kicks, one medium and one high, and possibly ending with a final
downward vertical kick with the heel. Due to the speed of rotation and the force of the
kicks, the target is lifted off the ground, and this buoyancy benefits the user, who utilizes
it to deliver increasingly precise and powerful blows.
The first kick is a feint, following the rules of Konoha Senp-. Then, you can unleash two
or three attacks using the Multiple Attack and Spinning Kick skills, or attack twice with
the Double Kick.

The principle of this taijutsu is to suddenly increase the body's abilities by opening the Sixth

He approaches his enemy and begins to punch him repeatedly. The punches are so fast

When the attack ends, the enemy is sent back to the ground, covered in the attack's

HIBON NINPOU (UNIQUE NINJA ART) Restricted Power You or your family have developed a unique Ninjutsu style, with fundamentals kept under lock and key and impossible for others to learn. Hibon Ninpou functions exactly like regular Ninpou power. Therefore, you need to define the theories and visual manifestations of your style. Hibon Ninpou has the same parameters as regular Ninpou plus two additional bonuses: choose two different ones from the following three; or choose the Additional Damage twice. • Additional Damage: Every Hibon Ninpou effect deals 1 additional point of damage as an more hardness. • Additional Hardness: Every creation of Hibon Ninpou has 2 points of added hardness. • Increased Resistance Difficulty: All effects of Hibon Ninpou receive a +1 bonus to the resistance difficulty for target tests. their body. If able to control it or obtain its cooperation, they gain access to vast
reserves of chakra and power. Every Tailed Beast provides its user with a reserve of
chakra and raw power, as well as special abilities that depend on the type of beast.
This power works based on active benefits, acquired through continuous use, as well
as passive benefits, acquired through its natural evolution.
any lower power mode is a free action.
Benefits Table: Each Bijuu is different and therefore has its own list of benefits. You
will automatically receive the benefits listed in the table as your power level increases.
Some Bijuu, like Shukaku (Ichibi), still possess the effects of an elemental power
mixed within the Jinchuuriki power. The elemental power also follows the benefit
table: you are only entitled to choose effects for the power at the levels specified by
the table.
The following rules are general for all types of Jinchuuriki. And at the end are the
specific benefits that the Kyuubi grants. To learn about the benefits of the other bijuu,
see the Book of Hijutsus.
Modes and Techniques: This power has modes of use and techniques. The modes
of the power (such as the Bijuu Cloak) have variable prerequisites depending on the
Bijuu.
Jinchuuriki for Players
The life of a Jinchuuriki is not easy. Besides the emotional issues related to
living with their own Bijuu, they also have to deal with the typically harsh
treatment from their village, since every Jinchuuriki is seen as a potential or
primary military force of the village. Sometimes, even other villages and
criminal organizations try to capture the Jinchuuriki to extract their Bijuu.
The Game Master can (and should) explore this within the story!
Techniques (like the Bijuudama) have fixed prerequisites, but they can also depend
in some way on the Jinchuuriki's power. It is not possible to use technique abilities
with any of the general Jinchuuriki power techniques.
Usage: Using Bijuu Presence is a free action, and using any other power mode is a
partial action, but requires the previous level mode to already be active. Returning to
Thus, using the Bijuu Cloak is a partial action, and using Bijuu Mode (which is the
subsequent mode) is also a partial action, but you must already have the Bijuu Cloak
active (remember that if you have already consumed your partial action this turn, you
can convert the move action into a partial action to use Bijuu Mode; see more in
Combat Actions, p. 253).
Unless the text states otherwise, the benefits of each mode of power are not
cumulative, as only one mode can be used.

the user's body, causing damage to their Vitality.
Techniques can be used by expending chakra or paying with Vitality points. The costs of the
techniques are in their descriptions.
Damage to Vitality: This is equal to the level of power used. The damage is suffered at the
moment of activation of the Bijuu Cloak or Bijuu Mode and at the beginning of each
subsequent turn. Using the Bijuu Cloak or Bijuu Mode causes damage to the Jinchuuriki's
body: in addition to having harmful chakra, the Bijuu always tries to take advantage of any
opportunity to break the seal and break free. You do not suffer damage when using Bijuu
Presence or Bijuu Form (provided it is not a forced transformation; see more below).
Safe Duration: 1 turn +1 per power level. This is the amount of time you can use the power
without losing control over the Bijuu during the scene. After this time, the Bijuu begins to
further tighten the seal: damage to Vitality is doubled, and even using Bijuu Presence causes
damage to the character.
Bijuu's Fact Sheet
If you need to create a Bijuu character sheet, you can follow these parameters.
Every Bijuu has a NC of 20. Distribute Attribute points using the normal rules for
characters and apply size modifiers. Do not purchase Skills (use the full Attribute level
if you need to make Skill checks).
The Bijuu has no abilities and possesses only one power, which is precisely the
Jinchuuriki level 10 power. However, it can only use the Bijuu Form (permanent
duration) and the techniques permitted by the form.
The Bijuu possesses infinite Vitality and Chakra. The only way to truly defeat it is by
sealing it within a person or special object created for this purpose.
Mastery Test: When your Vitality reaches zero while using the power, or when you experience
strong emotional stress (at the Master's discretion), you must perform a Mastery Test to keep
the Bijuu under control.
The mastery test is not precise: you roll 2 dice against a difficulty of 9. If you fail, you will
undergo a forced transformation into Bijuu Mode, releasing a tail, and enter a mental struggle
to remain conscious, but with temporary control over the Bijuu.
At the start of each subsequent turn, you must make a new mastery test with +1 difficulty
level, for three turns. If you fail 2 tests, you will completely lose consciousness and be treated
as an NPC, being dominated by the Bijuu and attacking everything and everyone within your
reach. Each turn the transformation will progress so that the jinchuuriki's appearance becomes
increasingly similar to that of their Bijuu (the pace of this transformation is at the GM's
discretion). When the transformation is complete, the character will die, leaving the beast free
in the world.
If you pass the tests, the transformation is contained, reverting completely. The power is
deactivated, and you will be exhausted for the rest of the day, unable to use it again until you
rest. If you try, you will initiate a forced transformation, automatically failing all mastery tests.
Jinchuuriki Death: If you die from losing control of the Tailed Beast, it is released. If you die
from any other cause, the Bijuu's chakra disperses throughout the world, remaining so for an
indefinite period until it rejoins, when the Bijuu is reborn free.
Total Control: When a Jinchuuriki reaches a certain power level, according to the Bijuu's
power chart, they gain total control and synergy with the tailed beast.
With full control, the user suffers no damage to their vitality when using any mode of the
power. Instead, using the power costs chakra equal to their Jinchuuriki power level, paid only
once while maintaining the power active, with no further chakra costs for switching between
modes.
The safe duration rule also ceases to exist, and the Jinchuuriki can use the
power freely throughout the scene without penalty. Conversely, it is no longer
possible to pay the cost of techniques using this power with Vitality.
Furthermore, if the Jinchuuriki allows it, the Bijuu can speak through them
when in Bijuu Form.
The Game Master can delay the granting of Full Control, or even place
conditions on it (such as developing a true friendship with the Bijuu), if they
deem it coherent and necessary for the campaign.

the Bijuu can use its own chakra to employ the Kai technique, freeing it from

Ninjas with sensory abilities are quite common. In Konoha alone, there are the
Aburame, Hyuuga, Inuzuka, Yamanaka, and Uzumaki clans (Kagura Shingan).
Narrating to a Sensor can be complicated most of the time (imagine trying to hide
something from the Byakugan!).
To maintain the element of surprise in adventures, you (the Game Master) can use
some of the following methods. The first is to take advantage of the sensor's weak
point (an Inuzuka, for example, might have their olfactory sense confused by a certain
smell).
The second is to create an anti-sensor barrier seal in the areas you wish to protect.
You can do this as a generic seal that forces the sensor ninja to make a Perception,
Alertness, Search, or Track test to find what they are looking for. Because it is a
generic technique, it is important that it can be easily removed if the source is found.
The third option is to require a Perception, Alertness, Search, or Track test for the
sensor character to find something in less time.
The better the test, the faster an enemy can be found.
If the character fails, they will still find the enemy (after all, they are a sensor and
there's no way they won't find them!), but the search will take a long time, or they will
only notice at the last minute, reducing their options for action.
Example: A group of enemies attempts to ambush the players. The tracker makes a
Readiness check to notice. If they fail, they only get one free action to warn their
allies about the ambush. If they succeed, they get one standard action before the
ambush. And if they score a critical hit, they get a full round!
In the shinobi world, there are various creatures that can be summoned to assist the
The character can extend the chakra suppression benefit to their allies, provided they
maintain direct contact with them to do so.
While your chakra is suppressed, you cannot use any jutsu, including the sensory
ability of the Kagura Shingan, or the suppression will be immediately canceled. This
restriction also applies to allies who benefit from chakra suppression.
Support Ninja: You only receive this benefit if you do not possess any other restricted
power or restricted aptitude besides Kagura Shingan. You receive the benefit of two
aptitudes chosen from the following options for free:
• Medical Ninja and Expert: Medicine
• Intuition and Mastery (for the technique or power of your choice)
• Fascinate and Mirage
You will not receive the benefits of skills for which you have not yet met the normal

ninja, both in combat and in espionage situations, or even for sending and receiving

Ninja dogs, excellent trackers, even giant frogs that use Suiton Ninjutsu.
Controlling these creatures is rare. To achieve this, the character must find someone who
possesses a Contract Scroll for a ninja creature and obtain permission to sign the scroll with
their blood, thus forging the contract. Once the contract is made, the character will be able
to train and learn the "Ninpou: Kuchiyose no Jutsu," the technique necessary to summon
the creatures. That's all.
Each character can only make one blood pact.
The level and abilities of the creature to be summoned will depend on the character's level
in this power. Beginners in this technique will only be able to summon mere helpers, small
creatures with little fighting power; while the most experienced can expend large amounts
of chakra to summon gigantic animals of equal power.
In the summoning process, the user needs small drops of blood for the jutsu to take effect
and requires a standard action.
Using the power: you can only use Kuchiyose once per scene, to summon 1 or 2 creatures
(some creatures, like the Dogs, can be summoned in greater numbers; see page 227).
Using it as a Hijutsu allows an additional use per scene (see further below).
If a creature's summoning is canceled for any reason (whether by the summoner's will, the
creature's own will, or because it has been defeated), you cannot summon another creature
in its place in the same scene.
When summoned, the creature appears beside you. If the creature serves as a mount, it
can be summoned beneath you, so you don't need to spend an action to mount it (see page
269).
Quantity, Levels, and Summoning Specs: When using the power, you must choose the
number of creatures you wish to summon and the...
Their level. Each creature has its own character sheet, which is created using the rules of
this power (see below).
Quantity: You can summon up to 2 creatures. Some summon species (such as Hounds)
can exceed this limit.
Maximum NC: equals twice the level of the power used; if summoning 2 creatures, the
maximum NC is reduced by 2 levels.
Therefore, if you have Kuchiyose 5, you can summon 1 creature with NL 10 or 2 creatures
with NL 8.
Chakra Cost: The chakra cost for performing the Kuchiyose no Jutsu is equal to twice the
power level used, regardless of the number of creatures.
Duration: The summoned creature will remain by the user's side for an uninterrupted
duration. However, if it is a rational creature, it may simply decide not to stay with the
summoner, returning to its place of origin of its own accord. The creature will also return
when its Vitality reaches zero or less, due to its survival instinct.
For these reasons, it is normal and advisable for the user of the Kuchiyose no Jutsu to form
bonds of friendship and trust with the summoned creatures.
When the bonds are very strong, the creature becomes so faithful and loyal that it faces any
kind of danger to fight alongside the summoner, even going so far as to die for them.
Commanding: Summons must be used according to the Command Partner rule (page
269). It is up to the player to create the character sheets for the creatures they will commonly
use during the game, simply choosing their levels and creating the sheets according to the
information of this power. Optionally, the creatures can have proper names and more
elaborate personalities.
Communication: all summons understand human language. Furthermore, unless otherwise
stated in the species information, all summons can also speak human language.
Restricted/Common Power: Kuchiyose can be purchased as a Hijutsu or as a common
power.
do not cause damage.

character or summon does not deal attack damage in that round (or has not attempted to

the same time as the Secret Technique version. You also gain access to the Senjutsu power
(Toads and Snakes) and the Byakugou no In technique (Slugs).
Common Power: If the character already possesses another Hijutsu or a Clan, they can still
purchase Kuchiyose as a common power, however the creatures are considered henchmen

The Master may allow you to initially purchase this power as a Hijutsu and, as the story
progresses, transform it into a regular power to acquire a different Hijutsu, provided you
haven't already acquired Senjutsu power or used the Byakugou no In technique.

Eagles
An eagle with colorful feathers, known for being used by characters from the
Land of the Air, its swooping attacks make it a formidable opponent.
They do not speak the human language.
Key Attributes: Agility and Perception.

assist the ninja in combat strategies.

Kyodaija ("Giant Snakes") are immense serpents endowed with great battle power. Most of

side.
Slugs have little offensive power, but they are great support, especially for medical ninjas, as
they can use the Iryou Ninjutsu power together with their Master and thus increase the healing
rate of injuries.

scene.

It takes many years to create the seal, with the most promising ninjas taking at least 3 years
to do so. When the seal is released, marks spread across the user and all chakra returns to
their body, granting them an immense regenerative capacity bordering on immortality.
Using the Seal: To create and maintain the seal, you must permanently reduce your Chakra
reserve by 15 points. When the seal is released, you double your total Chakra points

system.descricao: SENJUTSU (HERMIT TECHNIQUE) Restricted Power Prerequisite: see text Reach: Personal Action: 3 turns Duration: Continuous Type: Ninjutsu Subtype: Secret Technique Senjutsu are techniques that allow one to absorb and utilize nature energy by mixing it with the ninja's chakra. When the user manages to properly absorb nature energy and store it in their body, they enter a state called Sennin Mode (Sage Mode), which grants them a great increase in power. Prerequisites: Senjutsu is difficult to access, and few are those who manage to learn and master it. Even those who can be taught are sometimes not physically able to withstand its energy. nature. To purchase this power, you must have Stamina 14 and meet one of the following prerequisites: • Hermit Mode – Kuchiyose: Kuchiyose 8 (Restricted Power: Snakes or Frogs) + Greater Resistance (Vigor). Hermit Mode – Mokuton: Mokuton 8 + Increased Resistance (Stamina) or Regeneration. Optionally, the Master may allow other types of summoning, such as Monkeys, to also grant access to Senjutsu. Slugs should never grant access, as they grant techniques of a similar level. Senjutsu is a supplementary restricted power that depends on other restricted powers. You can (and should) purchase it with the restricted powers Kuchiyose and Mokuton, even without using the optional 2 Hijutsu rule. Entering Hermit Mode: You need to remain focused and motionless for 2 turns to enter Hermit Mode. If you are attacked during this time and take damage, or are forced to defend yourself, concentration is lost and must be restarted. At the end of the 2nd concentration round, Sage Mode is activated. You receive 1 Senjutsu Chakra point for each level of this power, and you can spend these points to gain one or more benefits during the fight (see below). Appearance: If you possess this power at level 7 or lower, you are still unable to properly balance your own chakra with nature energy, resulting in a stranger appearance during Sage Mode. A Frog Sage, for example, sees his nose grow and develop warts; his teeth become sharp, a goatee grows, and he acquires frog eyes. At level 8 of power, their appearance becomes perfect. The irises turn yellow, with pupils shaped similarly to those of the animals that taught the hermit mode (rectangular for frogs; thin and vertical for snakes). Around the eyes, a red or orange pigmentation appears for frogs, or purple for snakes. Those who acquire Senjutsu via Mokuton do not possess physical modifications related to animals. The irises turn yellow, but the pupil retains its normal shape. The pigmentation around the eyes can be red or green, and extends to near the ears. Additionally, they have a circular mark on their forehead, of the same color, with a dot in the center. Duration Limit: Once activated, Sage Mode lasts continuously as long as you possess at least 1 Senjutsu Chakra point. You can only obtain more Senjutsu Chakra after all points have been spent, requiring you to repeat all the steps to enter Sage Mode. Chakra Sensor: You receive the Sensor ability for free, with continuous duration while in Hermit Mode. This sensor is capable of distinguishing chakra signatures. Senjutsu Bonus: You can spend 1 Senjutsu Chakra point to receive one of the following bonuses. You cannot spend more than 1 point to receive the same bonus more than once, but you can spend more points to receive different bonuses at the same time. Energy bonuses last for 1 scene, and the other benefits last until the start of the next turn. Using any of these bonuses is a free action. • Strength +4 (does not stack with the base damage bonus below) • Base Damage +2 for an attack (including Energize) • Attack Accuracy +1 • Defense Accuracy +1 • Accelerated • Technical Difficulties +1 • Body Hardness +1 • Chakra +20 (1 time per scene) • Vitality +30 (1 time per scene) Quick Recharge of Nature Energy: There are 4 ways to obtain nature energy during combat without needing to remain stationary. • Through the Senpou: Ry-sei no Jutsu technique (Sage Art: Technique) of the Two Lives). • Using Kage Bunshins (True Clone ability) to absorb nature energy and dissipate it so that the energy comes to your body, recharging all Senjutsu Chakra points and instantly entering Sage Mode (if you are not already). You can create up to 2 clones for this, and you need to keep them in a quiet and safe place so that concentration is possible. For these clones, the damage reduction from the Command Partner rule does not apply. • Conduct experiments on your own body, such as adding cells from a Senninka kekkei genkai user (see Book of Secret Techniques) and enabling your body to passively absorb nature energy. Doing so requires Iryou Ninjutsu 10, Medicine 20, and Occultism 20, and allows you to recharge all Senjutsu Chakra points every 3 turns as a free action. • Possessing Senjutsu 8 and Mokuton 8, which allows you to recharge all Senjutsu Chakra points every 3 turns as a standard action. Having these powers at level 10 allows you to recharge as a free action. Gyaku Kuchiyose (Reverse Summoning): If you have gained access to Senjutsu by possessing Toad or Snake summons, you can perform the Kuchiyose no Jutsu in reverse to visit their sacred places (respectively Mount My-boku for Toads and Ry-chi Cave for Snakes). This cannot be done during combat. This also allows you to create fuuinjutsu scrolls that perform reverse summoning for you (which is extremely useful if you want to keep a Kage Bunshin around to absorb nature energy). Even if you don't have the Fuuinjutsu power, you can ask an ancient toad or snake to create it for you. Using a reverse summoning scroll to summon a clone is a standard action and costs 1 chakra point per clone. Transformation into Stone: Senjutsu Chakra is difficult to manipulate. A creature that drains the character's chakra while in Sage Mode – Kuchiyose is immediately turned to stone and dies, unless it also possesses Senjutsu power or the Senninka secret technique (see Book of Secret Techniques). system.descricao: VERSATILITY Restricted Power This power represents the exceptional capacity for understanding and learning possessed by the geniuses of the shinobi world, allowing them to master and explore diverse areas simultaneously. Versatility is a power that functions like Ninpou (see page 91), but with a major difference: you will have two different powers within one! Thus, with Versatility level 5, for example, you will be able to use Destructive Breath for Katon and also Arrows for Suiton. Choosing Versatile Powers: When you purchase Versatility, you need to choose two different powers that will be part of Versatility as Versatile Powers. So, using the previous example, you would have Versatile Fire Release and Versatile Water Release. Level 5 List of Versatile Powers: Ninpou, Suiton, Katon, Doton, Fuuton, Raiton, Fuuinjutsu. No other power outside this list can be chosen as versatile. Choosing Effects: On your character sheet, you must note both the Versatility power and its level, as well as the versatile powers you have chosen. With Versatility level 1, you receive the level effects of both versatile powers. So, following the same example, you would have the Cannon effect for the versatile Katon and also for the versatile Suiton. Starting at level 2, you will need to choose which versatile power will take effect at that level. So, if you choose that the Versatile Fire Release will receive level 2, you can choose any effect from that level for it, following the common Ninpo rules. Similarly, if you have Versatility 3 and choose the Versatile Suiton, you can choose any effect of level 3 or lower for it, including effects exclusive to the element. You can freely switch between level choices for versatile powers, but you must adhere to the maximum limit of 2 consecutive choices: if you choose 2 consecutive levels for a versatile power, the next level must be for the other power. So if you chose effects from Versatile Katon at levels 2 and 3, you must choose an effect from Versatile Suiton at level 4. Below is a complete example of Versatility 10, with Katon and Suiton Versatiles: Versatility Katon Versatile Versatile Suiton Level 1 Cannon Cannon Level 2 Fog Level 2 Level 3 Arrows Level 3 Level 4 Destructive Breath Level 4 Fog Level 5 Level 6 Wave Collision Level 6 Level 7 Destructive Breath Level 7 Level 8 Wave Collision Level 8 Level 9 Arrows Level 6 Level 10 Wave Collision Level 10 Using a Versatile Power: the versatile power continues to follow the same rules of use as its common form, with one difference: whenever you need to use the Power Level as a parameter, you use the level of your Versatility power. Therefore, if you have Versatility 6 and wish to use the Level 4 Destructive Breath of your Versatile Katon, you can use the power up to level 6 (which is your Versatility level), spending 6 chakra points to achieve the highest possible damage, following the generic rules of the Ninpou power. Benefits for Versatility: If you acquire a benefit for the Versatility power (such as the Mastery skill), this benefit will apply to both of your versatile powers (i.e., following the example, the accuracy bonus from Mastery will apply to both Versatile Fire Release and Versatile Water Release). Benefit: You can purchase the Versatility power a second time, choosing two different new versatile powers. The general benefits received from Versatility (such as from the Mastery skill) are retained for the new versatile powers. Purchase Prerequisites: Your Versatility level serves as a prerequisite for purchasing powers and abilities for your versatile power. Therefore, if you possess Versatility 5 and Versatile Suiton, you can purchase the Water Mastery skill (which requires Suiton 5 as a prerequisite). Elemental Affinity: The Versatility power does not count towards the elemental affinity rule limit (page 89). That is, even if you choose 2 elements as versatile powers, you will still be entitled to a third element during character creation, and a fourth element upon reaching Spirit 10. Clones with Tensai: The True Clone can freely use versatile powers. However, it does not receive the benefits of Tensai's Special Abilities (see below). Powers without Effects: If one of the versatile powers doesn't work with purchasing effects, but rather with a list of techniques that become available as the power evolves (like Fuuinjutsu), treat it as a power with effects. You have access to the chosen techniques at the levels where this power is selected. LIMITED ABILITIES FAST LEARNING You have an aptitude for mastering diverse fields of expertise. HIRAISHIN (FLYING GOD OF THUNDER) • Ninjutsu /Fuuinjutsu • Prerequisites: God of Thunder (aptitude) • Action: see text • Range: Touch or Undefined • Duration: Instantaneous (see text) • Chakra Cost: see text Hand Seals: No This technique consists of bending space-time to instantly move to a location predetermined by a permanent seal called a "formula technique" (jutsu-shiki). The name Hiraishin is a homophone of a Japanese word meaning "lightning rod." This may suggest why the technique is restricted to a seal, alluding to how lightning is attracted to lightning rods. Jutsu-Shiki (Seal): Before using the technique, the user must possess at least one seal distributed around the world. To apply this seal, the character must touch their target (in the case of an opponent, this can be done as a standard action and a CC check for an unarmed touch) and spend a partial action to create it. There is no limit to the number of seals that can be created, and creating a seal requires spending 1 chakra point. The seal must be placed in a space that is at least 10x10 cm in size. It is typically placed over an advanced seal strip. If placed on an advanced stamp strip, the stamp's duration is permanent. However, if created on any other surface, the duration is continuous until the end of the scene. Hiraishin for Gamers Hiraishin is one of the most difficult skills to master when you're a beginner Master in Shinobi no Sho. When the game starts at NC 16 or higher, it's even harder, as the character sheet can be completely built in a way that doesn't waste points (something that's more difficult to do when the game starts at a low NC). Therefore, if you're unsure, feel free to prohibit the Hiraishin technique for players. But remember to discuss this with them before starting the campaign! Destroying the surface on which the seal is located can cause it to break, such as removing the skin where the seal was applied or breaking a marked wall. To nullify a seal, Fuuinjutsu 8, a partial action, and 1 chakra point are required. Teleportation: This technique operates similarly to the Kuchiyose no Jutsu, allowing the user to travel through an empty plane and emerge at one of the locations marked by the jutsu-shiki, at the cost of 2 chakra points and a partial or movement action (of their choice). This technique can be used even if the character is grappled, restrained, or wearing heavy armor. The user is able to affect anything they are touching, making it possible to teleport people and objects along with them (touching a person requires a CC test against their defense). A touched object cannot be teleported alone: the user is required to teleport along with the object. The technique becomes more expensive depending on the quantity and size of what is being transported, as shown in the table. Size Chakra Cost +1 Small +3 Average +5 Big +7 Huge +9 Huge Colossal +11 Scatter Kunai: If the character possesses the Quick Draw skill, they can use a partial action to throw up to 8 kunai, previously marked with the jutsu-shiki, around the battlefield, covering an area of 16m in diameter. These kunai are special, slightly larger than regular kunai, as they need enough space to contain the jutsu-shiki, which is placed in an advanced seal and attached to the kunai's handle. Apart from that, they possess the same characteristics as common kunai (such as compartment size, reach, and damage) and can be used for the same purposes, such as ranged attacks, close-quarters combat, or throwing with explosive tags (in this case, note that the explosion of the tag will damage the jutsu-shiki; the same happens if the kunai is energized). Vanish: The character disappears at the last second, teleporting across the battlefield within millimeters of being hit by the attack. Vanish must be used in conjunction with Dodge or Anticipate, and you must announce this when choosing a defense, paying the chakra cost. When an opponent makes a successful attack (other than a critical hit), using this ability forces them to reroll their attack roll and keep the worst result of the two (even if the second result is a critical hit).
